criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slides 1, 2 and 7 work. Slide 5's kit head crosses the kicker, hands read as mittens, brown mid tone field. Slide 8 white collar tabs and a window that reads as a blank board. Slide 4 pale desktop floods the lower third, sheet a white bar, no contact shadow. Slide 3 far lids alias, hero small. Lawn tufts stamped. Slide 9 walker's hair a white column.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hero desk on all nine, the walk a spine across 1, 6, 7 and 9, west light throughout, motif evolution and camera move visible. Slide 5's warm brown sky and slide 4's pale desktop are value jumps.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Loose spots: slide 9 art shows the walker toward the town hall paver under 'Community members are invited too' though that event is the Faculty and Student town hall; slide 4 hook 'a use policy' on a medium confidence claim; 'two committees' reads c4's plural.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, how many, the tension and a dated way in are all there; no county on a frame, the public seminar's time never on a slide, no URL for the form.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Turn at 4 is the best beat; 5 repeats 2; 6 and 8 both carry October 12th; the cover hook is a topic statement.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register; slide 6 and 7 headlines talk about the drawing; cover hook generic.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject; the last light world repeats no. 46, one per day along a walk echoes no. 46's lamp per day, the walker close repeats no. 43, the multiplied hero repeats nos. 43 and 47.

one_sentence_fix: Take slides 6, 7 and 9 off the paver conceit and onto what a reader can act on: slide 7 says outright that no vote, date or body decides, and slide 9 closes on the public October 22nd seminar at Highland, 6 to 9 p.m., with the form's page named.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: White collar tab on every seated figure; the window reads as a blank brown board, so the room's light has no source.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove the collar tab; model the back wall rectangle as a real window with mullions and a warm exterior whose light rakes the lectern and floor.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Low poly head crosses the kicker, mitten hands, brown mid tone field.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Over the shoulder crop with the head out of frame left and above the type band; sky to near black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Pale desktop floods the lower third, sheet a white bar, laptop hovers.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Narrow the key to a pool under the laptop, contact shadows under its feet, sheet turned off axis.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Far lids alias into moire; hero small.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Plain low emissive on the instanced far lids; hero forward and larger, at least 400 px tall.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin walker with a white column of hair; walker and desk under a third of the frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dark hair or a hood; camera in so walker and desk fill a third of the frame; vary the tufts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Desk small at lower left, right half empty lawn with floating labels.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower and push the camera along the walk; labels against their inlays.
